types.name: Position from either end
types.description: One person's position from the left or top and from the right or bottom (or the total) is given; asks the total number of people or the position from the other end.

types.name: People between two persons
types.description: Positions of two people in a row are given from the same or opposite ends; asks how many people stand between them, or the total when someone stands exactly in the middle.

types.name: Interchanged positions
types.description: Two people swap places and one new position is given; asks the total number of people or a new position.

types.name: Comparison (taller, heavier)
types.description: People or objects are compared by height, weight, marks or age (A is taller than B but shorter than C); asks who is tallest, heaviest, or in the middle.

types.name: Rank and position puzzles
types.description: People are placed in ranks or in a line using conditions like "just above", "just below", "between", "not at the lowest"; asks who is at a given rank or position.
